mentions.name: kpbj.fm website and archiving system
mentions.description: A website and archiving system for the KPBJ FM community radio station, built with Haskell and htmx. A temporary static HTML site is currently live while the full system is under development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Since this is hackernews, i'll add that i'm building the website and archiving system using haskell and htmx, but what is currently live is a temp static html site.
https://github.com/solomon-b/kpbj.fm
